test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

You are requested to come early tomorrow.

options.text: I request your early coming tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Please come early tomorrow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** passive voice**, as it starts with "You are requested," indicating a polite request.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence needs to be rewritten to directly convey the request while maintaining the same meaning.
 
• Option 3, "Please come early tomorrow," is the most appropriate active voice conversion because it is polite and directly conveys the request.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 4 are either grammatically incorrect or do not match the tone and intent of the original sentence.

Correct sentence: *Please come early tomorrow*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive to Active Voice Conversion Tips:**

 
 
• Identify the subject performing the action in the passive sentence.
 
• Rewrite the sentence so that the subject appears at the beginning, performing the action.
 
• Use appropriate verbs and maintain the tone of the original sentence (e.g., polite requests should remain polite).
 
 
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• Passive: "The homework was completed by the student." → Active: "The student completed the homework."
 
• Passive: "You are advised to take precautions." → Active: "Please take precautions."
